title: A Market Defined by Style and Selection
description: Explore Miami’s thriving yacht market: top yachts under 100 feet featuring Sunseeker, Azimut, Pershing and Custom Line designs blending luxury, performance and style.
html:
Miami’s yacht market continues to thrive, offering a vibrant mix of design, innovation, and lifestyle appeal. For those seeking yachts under 100 feet, the current selection includes some of the most refined vessels available — from the newest tri-deck designs to timeless Italian builds and high-performance express yachts. Each of the following listings reflects Miami’s distinct blend of sophistication, energy, and world-class craftsmanship.

88ft Sunseeker 2024

88ft Sunseeker 2024 – WORTH THE WAIT

The all-new Sunseeker Ocean 90 Enclosed, also known as the Ocean 182, stands as a statement of forward-thinking yacht design. With an impressive 24-foot beam, this tri-deck model offers the interior volume of a much larger yacht while maintaining sleek, contemporary lines. Expansive salon windows flood the main deck with natural light, while the upper sky lounge provides panoramic views and a private retreat for entertaining. Multiple alfresco areas extend the social spaces, making every deck an opportunity to enjoy life on the water. Backed by a transferable extended warranty through 2028 and recognized as the “Best Layout” winner in the 80′ to 98′ category at the 2023 World Yacht Trophies, Worth the Wait represents the future of Sunseeker’s luxury and performance heritage.

95ft Azimut 2017

95ft Azimut 2017

This 95-foot Azimut Raised Pilothouse perfectly captures the essence of Italian craftsmanship, showcasing an exceptional balance of style, innovation, and comfort. With very low hours and a range of custom upgrades, it offers both pristine condition and thoughtful design. The yacht’s spacious five-stateroom layout provides flexibility for family cruising or charter use, while the seamless connection between interior and exterior living areas enhances the onboard experience. Every element, from its expansive salon to the flybridge’s open-air entertaining space, reflects Azimut’s signature attention to detail and modern elegance — making it an outstanding opportunity for buyers seeking pedigree and performance.

92ft Pershing 2013

92ft Pershing 2013

A striking combination of speed, design, and craftsmanship, this 92-foot Pershing embodies everything the brand is known for. Capable of reaching 40 knots, it offers exhilarating performance without sacrificing comfort or refinement. The yacht’s sleek profile is matched by an interior designed for luxury living, featuring elegant furnishings and an open, light-filled layout. On deck, the flybridge becomes the social centerpiece, equipped with a grill, bar, sun pads, and shaded lounge areas that make it ideal for entertaining. Built for those who appreciate both innovation and adrenaline, this Pershing is the ultimate expression of power and prestige on the water.

92ft Custom Line 2015

92ft Custom Line Navetta 28 2015 – D’VINCI

Built by Ferretti’s Custom Line division, D’Vinci is a Navetta 28 that delivers superyacht luxury in an under-100-foot package. Designed by Zuccon International Project, her tri-deck configuration creates an extraordinary sense of space, while features such as the Dual Mode Transom, panoramic upper dining area, and full-beam master suite elevate her beyond expectation. The yacht accommodates up to eleven guests in five ensuite cabins, all finished to the highest standards. Equipped with twin MAN diesel engines, zero-speed stabilizers, Seakeeper gyros, upgraded A/V systems, and Starlink connectivity, D’Vinci blends long-range cruising capability with modern technology and elegant design. Every detail, from her seamless indoor-outdoor flow to her expansive beach club, is crafted for those who want the sophistication of a superyacht without the operational complexity of one.

86ft Sunseeker 2021

86ft Sunseeker 2021

This 86-foot Sunseeker delivers the perfect mix of power, comfort, and contemporary styling. With a generous 21-foot beam, four ensuite cabins, and a striking open-plan layout, it was built for entertaining and extended cruising alike. Twin MTU 12V2000 M96L engines provide a smooth and efficient 23-knot cruise, while her meticulous maintenance ensures complete readiness for her next owner. Recent updates include a five-year survey, fresh bottom paint, running gear service, and full mechanical and A/C maintenance. As an expression of Sunseeker’s continuing evolution, this yacht exemplifies the brand’s commitment to engineering excellence and luxury living on the water.

Explore Miami’s Finest Yachts

Each of these vessels showcases a different facet of Miami’s dynamic yacht market — from groundbreaking design to established craftsmanship — yet all share the same standard of quality and allure. Whether you’re seeking cutting-edge innovation, timeless style, or proven performance, Miami offers an unmatched selection of yachts under 100 feet ready for immediate enjoyment.

To learn more or schedule a private showing, contact FYI Yachts and experience firsthand the artistry and adventure that define yachting in South Florida.
